text: What is the primary difference between a Departmental Undertaking and a Statutory Corporation?
options: It is owned by the government, but operates independently.
It is a separate legal entity, but is owned by the government.
It is a department of the government, but has its own budget.
It is a private company, but is contracted by the government to provide services.
correctAnswer: It is a department of the government, but has its own budget.
explanation: Departmental Undertaking is a part of the government, but has its own budget and autonomy. On the other hand, a Statutory Corporation is a separate legal entity, but is owned by the government.

text: Which of the following is a feature of a Government Company?
options: It is owned by the government, but operates independently.
It is a separate legal entity, but is owned by the government.
It has a single shareholder, which is the government.
It is a private company, but is contracted by the government to provide services.
correctAnswer: It has a single shareholder, which is the government.
explanation: A Government Company is a company in which the government has a majority stake, but it operates independently. It has a single shareholder, which is the government.
